name: orion
description: Search, edit, research, import, export, and generate in your local Orion Spaces.

interface.shortDescription: Your local knowledge atlas, available in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Use Orion's local library and optional AI/context workflows from Codex. Search and cite exact notes, edit knowledge, import source material through Orion's synthesis flow, research evidence, generate notes and decks, and refresh canonical knowledge. Orion retains provider credentials and settings. Enable workflow Spaces, API use, and writes in Orion Connections. Inspect exact passages, sections, tasks, provenance, concepts and link paths. Make version-guarded edits and atomic metadata updates, and diagnose duplicates or broken references. Includes 55 tools across local knowledge, native AI workflows, in-note edit review, active-editor context, selected-text AI actions and existing voice work orders. Inspect or cancel a specific worker, or continue its read-only research with exact revision guards; microphone and call controls remain in Orion. Ask AI questions with exact Space evidence, search preserved sources, and export editable Word documents through Orion’s native save dialog. Create movable writing blocks and other slash-command content with guarded local edits.
defaultPrompt: Research my Orion Space and cite the supporting evidence.
Import this material through Orion’s knowledge flow.
Generate a briefing from the notes in my Orion Space.
